INSERT IGNORE INTO infofee01_rag.if_embed_claims (
    ChunkUUIDBin,
    ClaimTokenBin,
    ClaimedAt,
    ExpiresAt
)
SELECT
    c.ChunkUUIDBin,
    UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($1),
    NOW(6),
    DATE_ADD(NOW(6), INTERVAL 90 MINUTE)

FROM infofee01_rag.if_chunks AS c

LEFT JOIN infofee01_rag.if_embed_claims AS existing
    ON existing.ChunkUUIDBin = c.ChunkUUIDBin

WHERE existing.ChunkUUIDBin IS NULL

  AND c.ChunkEmbedding IS NULL
  AND c.EmbedStatus = 'pending'
  AND c.EmbedAttempts < 5

  AND (
      c.EmbedNextAttemptAt IS NULL
      OR c.EmbedNextAttemptAt <= NOW()
  )

ORDER BY
    c.EmbedNextAttemptAt,
    c.TextUUIDBin,
    c.ChunkChunkNumber,
    c.ChunkUUIDBin

LIMIT 32;

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_chunks AS c

JOIN infofee01_rag.if_embed_claims AS q
    ON q.ChunkUUIDBin = c.ChunkUUIDBin

SET
    c.ChunkEmbedding = VEC_FromText($1),
    c.EmbedStatus = 'done',
    c.EmbedLastError = NULL,
    c.EmbedFinishedAt = NOW(),
    c.EmbedNextAttemptAt = NULL

WHERE c.ChunkUUIDBin = UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($2)

  AND q.ClaimTokenBin = UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($3)

  AND c.EmbedStatus = 'processing'
  AND c.ChunkEmbedding IS NULL
  AND q.ExpiresAt > NOW();

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_chunks AS c

JOIN infofee01_rag.if_embed_claims AS q
    ON q.ChunkUUIDBin = c.ChunkUUIDBin

SET
    c.EmbedStatus = CASE
        WHEN c.EmbedAttempts >= 5 THEN 'failed'
        ELSE 'pending'
    END,

    c.EmbedLastError = $1,

    c.EmbedStartedAt = NULL,

    c.EmbedFinishedAt = CASE
        WHEN c.EmbedAttempts >= 5 THEN NOW()
        ELSE NULL
    END,

    c.EmbedNextAttemptAt = CASE
        WHEN c.EmbedAttempts >= 5 THEN NULL
        ELSE TIMESTAMPADD(
            MINUTE,
            LEAST(
                POWER(2, GREATEST(c.EmbedAttempts - 1, 0)),
                30
            ),
            NOW()
        )
    END

WHERE c.ChunkUUIDBin = UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($2)

  AND q.ClaimTokenBin = UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($3)

  AND c.ChunkEmbedding IS NULL
  AND c.EmbedStatus = 'processing'
  AND q.ExpiresAt > NOW();

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_chunks AS c

JOIN infofee01_rag.if_embed_claims AS q
    ON q.ChunkUUIDBin = c.ChunkUUIDBin

SET
    c.EmbedStatus = 'processing',
    c.EmbedAttempts = c.EmbedAttempts + 1,
    c.EmbedStartedAt = NOW(),
    c.EmbedFinishedAt = NULL,
    c.EmbedNextAttemptAt = NULL,
    c.EmbedLastError = NULL

WHERE c.ChunkUUIDBin = UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($1)
  AND q.ClaimTokenBin = UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($2)

  AND q.ExpiresAt > NOW()

  AND c.ChunkEmbedding IS NULL
  AND c.EmbedStatus = 'pending'
  AND c.EmbedAttempts < 5;

INSERT INTO infofee01_rag.if_extraction_log (
    TextUUIDBin,
    Stage,
    Status,
    Message,
    LoggedAt
)
SELECT
    TextUUIDBin,
    'embed',
    CASE
        WHEN EmbedStatus = 'failed' THEN 'failed'
        ELSE 'retry'
    END,
    CONCAT(
        CASE
            WHEN EmbedStatus = 'failed'
                THEN 'EMBED_DEAD_LETTER: '
            ELSE 'EMBED_RETRY: '
        END,
        COALESCE(EmbedLastError, 'unknown'),
        ' for chunk ',
        BIN_TO_UUID_MDB(ChunkUUIDBin),
        ' attempt ',
        EmbedAttempts,
        '/5'
    ),
    NOW()
FROM infofee01_rag.if_chunks
WHERE ChunkUUIDBin = UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($1);

INSERT INTO infofee01_rag.if_extraction_log (
  TextUUIDBin, 
  Stage, 
  Status, 
  Message, 
  LoggedAt
) VALUES (
  UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($1), 
  'embed', 
  'done', 
  CONCAT('embedded chunk ', $2), 
  NOW()
);

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_chunks AS c
JOIN infofee01_rag.if_embed_claims AS q
    ON q.ChunkUUIDBin = c.ChunkUUIDBin
SET
    c.EmbedStatus = CASE
        WHEN c.EmbedAttempts >= 5 THEN 'failed'
        ELSE 'pending'
    END,

    c.EmbedLastError = 'CLAIM_EXPIRED',

    c.EmbedStartedAt = NULL,

    c.EmbedFinishedAt = CASE
        WHEN c.EmbedAttempts >= 5 THEN NOW()
        ELSE NULL
    END,

    c.EmbedNextAttemptAt = CASE
        WHEN c.EmbedAttempts >= 5 THEN NULL
        ELSE NOW()
    END

WHERE q.ExpiresAt <= NOW()
  AND c.ChunkEmbedding IS NULL;

DELETE FROM infofee01_rag.if_embed_claims
WHERE ExpiresAt <= NOW();
SELECT UUID() AS ClaimToken;

SELECT
    BIN_TO_UUID_MDB(c.ChunkUUIDBin) AS ChunkUUID,
    BIN_TO_UUID_MDB(c.TextUUIDBin) AS TextUUID,

    c.ChunkChunkNumber,
    c.ChunkText,
    CHAR_LENGTH(c.ChunkText) AS ChunkTextLength,

    c.EmbedStatus,
    c.EmbedAttempts,

    BIN_TO_UUID_MDB(q.ClaimTokenBin) AS ClaimToken,
    q.ClaimedAt,
    q.ExpiresAt

FROM infofee01_rag.if_embed_claims AS q

JOIN infofee01_rag.if_chunks AS c
    ON c.ChunkUUIDBin = q.ChunkUUIDBin

WHERE q.ClaimTokenBin = UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($1)

  AND c.ChunkEmbedding IS NULL
  AND c.EmbedStatus = 'pending'

ORDER BY
    c.TextUUIDBin,
    c.ChunkChunkNumber,
    c.ChunkUUIDBin;

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_chunks AS c

LEFT JOIN infofee01_rag.if_embed_claims AS q
    ON q.ChunkUUIDBin = c.ChunkUUIDBin

SET
    c.EmbedStatus = CASE
        WHEN c.EmbedAttempts >= 5 THEN 'failed'
        ELSE 'pending'
    END,

    c.EmbedLastError = 'ORPHANED_PROCESSING',

    c.EmbedStartedAt = NULL,

    c.EmbedFinishedAt = CASE
        WHEN c.EmbedAttempts >= 5 THEN NOW()
        ELSE NULL
    END,

    c.EmbedNextAttemptAt = CASE
        WHEN c.EmbedAttempts >= 5 THEN NULL
        ELSE NOW()
    END

WHERE c.ChunkEmbedding IS NULL
  AND c.EmbedStatus = 'processing'
  AND q.ChunkUUIDBin IS NULL
  AND (
      c.EmbedStartedAt IS NULL
      OR c.EmbedStartedAt < NOW() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE
  );
